title: Bootstrap league, divisions, clubs and season from BHPLTA in-app
description: Leagues are only ever created by cmd/populate-db (hardcoded BHPLTA 2025) and divisions only by populate-db or by copying a prior season, so a new instance has no way to get its structure. Since the product is BHPLTA-only, setup does this for the club: after the club is chosen, the app creates the BHPLTA league, scrapes the current season's fixtures (internal/services/fixture_scraper.go, as cmd/import-season does), creates divisions, all clubs and teams, weeks and fixtures, imports club venue data (club_scraper), marks the chosen club as home, and reports what it created. The same action is available later from admin as 'Start a new season from BHPLTA' for instances with no previous season to copy. BHPLTA being unreachable or changing its markup must produce a clear, retryable message, never a half-built season.

recommended_model.name: Opus 5.5
recommended_model.rationale: Lifts CLI logic into a transactional service across several repositories, with failure handling against an external site.

acceptance_criteria: From an empty database, choosing a club in setup results in a league, divisions, clubs, teams, weeks and fixtures for the current BHPLTA season, with the chosen club set as home
The whole import runs in a transaction; any failure leaves the database as it was and shows a retry option
A summary screen lists counts created and anything that could not be matched
The action is repeatable from admin for a later season without duplicating clubs or teams
Scraper failures (network error, unexpected markup) surface as a readable message naming what failed
cmd/import-season and cmd/populate-db are no longer needed for a new club (they may remain for the author's use)

files_to_modify: cmd/import-season/main.go (lift logic into a shared service)
notes: cmd/import-season currently requires clubs to exist (lines 194-197) - the shared service must create them.
Week count defaults to 18 and second-half start is derived from it (team_eligibility.go:429-441); keep those rules as they are.
Record scraper fixtures (saved HTML) for tests so the suite does not hit bhplta.co.uk.

testing_requirements: Service tests against saved BHPLTA HTML fixtures
Rollback test: inject a failure midway and assert no rows remain

context.user_story: As a new club, I want my divisions, opponents and fixtures to appear without typing them in.
context.programme: Club-readiness programme (sprints 019-024). Agreed constraints: BHPLTA clubs only; each club self-hosts its own instance; the original author must have no access to any other club's instance (no seeded accounts, no shared or default secrets, no phone-home); passkeys are the default sign-in with passwords as an optional fallback; the captain role is real; SQLite is the only supported database; CourtHive is bundled as an opt-in part of the package so clubs can run their own club championships.
